content.thinking:
The bug is in `removeMember`.

`removeMember` passes `"owner"` as the next role to `assertLastOwnerRetained`, which causes an early return and skips the check entirely. Demotion works because it passes the actual new role. The comment says a removed owner should demote to "no role at all", but the role type has no "none" value.

The fix is to pass a non-owner role such as `"member"` or `"viewer"` when removing a member. This makes the invariant check fire and prevents accidental owner loss.
